desc:
# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/omnivore
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/omnivore

## File: facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivore/models/omnivore_model.py

Prompts

```
['build a python module to load the pretrained Omnivore Swin-B model with all three classification heads', 'build a python module to load the pretrained Omnivore Swin-Tiny model for image video and rgbd tasks', 'run the OmnivoreModel forward pass on a 5D tensor with a specified input type', 'build a python module to load the Omnivore Swin-L model pretrained on ImageNet 21K', 'create a ModuleDict with image rgbd and video classification heads using get_all_heads']
```

Usage

```
{'build_omnivore_swinB_model': 'build a python module to load the pretrained Omnivore Swin-B model with all three classification heads', 'build_omnivore_swinT_model': 'build a python module to load the pretrained Omnivore Swin-Tiny model for image video and rgbd tasks', 'run_OmnivoreModel_forward': 'run the OmnivoreModel forward pass on a 5D tensor with a specified input type', 'build_omnivore_swinL_imagenet21k_model': 'build a python module to load the Omnivore Swin-L model pretrained on ImageNet 21K', 'create_get_all_heads': 'create a ModuleDict with image rgbd and video classification heads using get_all_heads'}
```
